items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Sonny Greer will tell you about those Washingtonian

ctx.x: Howard University, because see at that time Duke had left there. Claude Hopkins' family, I think they was -- his mother or something was a professor or somebody dean or something, see, Claude Hopkins was a very high class individual. He's a dogmatic man, but in his way, he's all right. He's beautiful. That's the real Washingtonian way and by the way, Sonny Greer will tell you about those Washingtonian, and then I went to the theatre, the Howard Theatre one time and I looked at the show, it was called Shake Your…

had to forget that. So now I'm playing my gigs and things are running smooth. So they had a little gathering up on the second floor, called the Smart Set Social Club, so I said I'm going up here and try my hand out in the gambling. I went up there and they paid me $5.00 for that gig and I said, there wasn't nobody up there but the caretaker,whatever he was and this man had hands about 10 inches long and the stick was almost that long. He said, all right, then, here we go. I said $1.00. I threw them dice on 12, so…
